guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use only .github/workflows/release.yml for immutable tag and provider Release mutations; never create, move, delete, or republish a release manually.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Release publication is constrained to the repository's authoritative release.yml workflow; no manual provider mutation is permitted.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve readiness → archive/pre-merge freeze → PR merge → same-SHA rehearsal → receipt-bound publication → independent post-publication verification → Work Item closure.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Contract acceptance and release documentation define this order; each boundary will be recorded before the next action.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat Outcome and chat claims as handoff summaries only; public release truth must come from provider, tag, asset, and command evidence.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Contract requires independent tag, Release, asset, digest, installer, and command checks before a green Outcome.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Never reuse or mutate a failed immutable tag; quarantine failed provider evidence and use a new corrective patch release if the workflow fails after tag creation.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The release Contract explicitly excludes historical tag mutation and requires fail-closed handling.

risk.detail: v0.5.68 is an immutable public release; exact source, rehearsal, provider, asset, installer, and lifecycle evidence remain mandatory before completion.

observedIssues.detail: Two exact-SHA Smoke runs used identical manifest, plan, source tree, and 85.10% floor; the passing run covered two lock-lease JSONDecodeError lines through a concurrent race, while the failing run did not and aggregated at 85.09%.
observedIssues.resolution: Add deterministic malformed-lock regression coverage before rerunning the release workflow.
